---
title: "Mathematics"
---

The mathematical foundations behind statistics, machine learning, and data
science. Work through the pages in order, returning to earlier ideas as needed.

## Learning order

1. [Linear Algebra](linear-algebra.qmd) — vectors, matrices, systems, and transformations.
2. [Calculus](calculus.qmd) — rates of change, accumulation, and gradients.
3. [Probability Theory](probability-theory.qmd) — uncertainty, conditioning, and random variables.
4. [Optimisation](optimisation.qmd) — objectives, constraints, and gradient-based search.

## Further resources

- [OpenStax Mathematics](https://openstax.org/subjects/math) — free introductory textbooks.
- [MIT OpenCourseWare](https://ocw.mit.edu/search/?d=Mathematics) — lecture notes and exercises.
